name: Easy Notif
overview: Send email notifications to your users: new-media newsletters, weekly watch recaps and manual admin emails.
description: An internal email notification service for Jellyfin. Schedule a newsletter of newly added media, send each user a personalised weekly watch recap, and write one-off announcements from the dashboard. Uses Resend for delivery. Reads the library and playback data only, never modifies anything.
